newsitem.title: USA: Arkansas Best completes Cardinal sale.
newsitem.headline: Arkansas Best completes Cardinal sale.

text.p: Arkansas Best Corp said Tuesday it had completed the sale of Cardinal Freight Carriers Inc for about $38 million in cash to a company organized by Golder, Thoma, Cressey, Rauner, Inc.
As previously reported, the sale results in a pre-tax gain of $8 million to $9 million, subject to adjustments in the purchase price under the terms of the definitive agreement.

Arkansas Best said it used net proceeds from the sale to pay down bank debt. It said the cut in bank debt, together with improved operating performance in 1997, has resulted in a reduction of 3/4 of 1 percent in the interest rate on the its bank debt.

Cardinal Freight is an irregular route truckload carrier headquartered in Concord, North Carolina. Cardinal reported revenues of about $75 million in 1996 and operating profit of about $4.4 million on a segment basis.
